top_choice_rationale: P004 pairs the clearest general method on the list, ligand-controlled Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling by Buchwald and Hartwig, which changed how arylamines are made in medicinal and process chemistry, with Liu's base editing, where the new chemistry is concrete (deaminase acting in a Cas-exposed single-stranded window, an evolved adenine deaminase). It keeps three names with clean credit. If the committee prefers protein degradation, P003 is my next choice because it keeps Liu and limits PROTAC credit to the conceivers, followed by the Ciulli trio (chemistry of VHL ligands and ternary-complex design) and then the Handa trio. Any award is preferred to no award.
